About me

I am a third-year Mechatronics Engineering student at the University of Basrah, passionate about applying engineering concepts to real-world challenges.

My interests include robotics, embedded systems, industrial instrumentation and process control, with a focus on the oil and gas industry. Through academic projects, technical training, industrial visits and student activities, I keep building my practical skills, technical knowledge and teamwork.

My goal: to become a skilled Mechatronics Engineer who connects mechanical, electrical and control systems to develop practical engineering solutions.

Engineering projects

SU-22 aircraft

Converting an existing aircraft model into a remotely controlled flying model by integrating electronic and control systems.

  • Aircraft design
  • Electric propulsion
  • ESC
  • RC control
  • Servo control

F1 RC car control system

Developing the control and motion systems of a radio-controlled car for reliable movement and steering.

  • DC motor control
  • ESC
  • Steering servo
  • Wireless communication

PixyCam Arduino car

A vision-based robotic vehicle: the PixyCam tracks visual objects and the Arduino uses that data to drive the car.

  • Arduino
  • Computer vision
  • Sensor integration
  • Robotic motion

Arduino-based mobile robot

One robot with three control modes: ultrasonic obstacle avoidance, voice commands and Bluetooth mobile control.

  • Ultrasonic sensing
  • Voice control
  • Bluetooth
  • Motor control

Spider robot, 12 servo motors

A multi-legged walking robot using 12 servos for coordinated leg movement.

  • Servo control
  • Mechanical design
  • Embedded control

AI assistant for oil & gas pipe recognition
